extraction.application_description_projection: Site plan application for two two-storey data centre buildings, each with a one-storey office component, about 38 at-grade generators, a future utility substation and an interlinked driveway system.

cross_check.result: York Region address point 259374 (6100 Langstaff Road, Vaughan, type Parcel, Active) at -79.62940004, 43.79223517 lies inside the application polygon, 75.8 m from the service centroid. It is not used as the locator.

identity_chain: Microsoft's August 5, 2026 construction update names its Vaughan datacentre in the City of Vaughan, Ontario, with EllisDon as construction contact, and refers to a second building.

York Region's official active development application layer returns exactly one feature whose applicant name contains Microsoft: application 22556 (SP.22.V.0111 / DA.22.008), '3288212 Nova Scotia Ltd.; Microsoft Data Processing Centre YTO11', at 6100 Langstaff Road in Vaughan, for two data centre buildings.
The two-building application matches Microsoft's first building plus planned second building at the Vaughan site.
The service returns a centroid inside the application polygon; the region's own address point for 6100 Langstaff Road lies inside the same polygon.
precision: Service centroid of York Region's boundary for Microsoft's two-building YTO11 site plan application (about 11.3 ha). A campus marker; not the first building's footprint, entrance, substation, or a surveyed property boundary.
uncertainty_reason: The regional service publishes no positional accuracy. The application boundary extends up to about 287 m from the centroid, and the first building's position within it is not mapped.
excluded_geometry: Microsoft Canada offices, the Woodbridge postal-code area and third-party directory coordinates are not used. The address point is used only as a cross-check.
